the parameters identified in the literature are not sufficient to describe all the innovations in the OED corpus.
the OED innovations are not as idiosyncratically creative as they are usually described.

we are interested in the question, how a word formation process can be described in a way that allows us to distinguish between regular and irregular formations and that is at the same time compatible with a general theory of language.

the OED data show that the creativity of the writers under study is not a binary phenomenon, but a matter of degree.
